profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Developer with a desire to innovate business solutions by applying practical programming methodologies. Versed in object-oriented programming concepts, unit testing and server endpoint implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Senior Associate
positions.description:
Engineered a backend microservice utilizing Amazon Data Firehose to interface with a vendor’s payment processing API, ensuring real-time, secure data processing with retry mechanisms in place for reduced transaction failure rates.

Created an AWS Resource wizard in collaboration with UX stakeholders using Next.js, React, and TypeScript, transforming Adobe XD designs into a responsive, security-compliant tool that reduces resource provisioning time.

Leveraged Python, Flask, and SQLAlchemy to craft detailed models and efficient, integrity-driven database operations that
simplified complex transactional queries for customer metadata for buyer profiles.

Worked with security, finance, and development teams to define role-based access policies, set security groups, and establish accurate cost projections for AWS resources needed to develop employee learning platform while integrating with internal SSO approach.

Utilized Pytest fixtures and parameterized tests to simulate unique user scenarios, ensuring robust coverage and identifying edge cases for an associate support feedback web form on a documentation page view.
positions.insights: React, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +6 skills

positions.title: Computer Science Curriculum Implementation
positions.description:
- Developing and overseeing the strategy and implementation of Computer Science curricula for elementary school age students, culminating in portfolios of their projects and works
- Collaborating with administration to enhance effectiveness of classroom instruction using digital teaching methods and applications
- Researching and recommending the purchase of digital knowledge based technologies as well as following up with support and instruction
- Designing and improving curricula facets that strengthen technical knowledge and educational results
